description: Git-native ticket management board backed by the .tickets/ directory of a GitHub repository.
config.repo: Target repository in `owner/repo` form. Leave empty to infer from the workspace `origin` remote.
config.branch: Target branch. Leave empty to infer from the workspace current branch.
config.provider: Ticket store provider. `github-contents` uses `.tickets/*.md` via the Contents API. `github-issues` uses GitHub Issues.
